# GitHub repository metadata

Values for the repository's **About** panel (top right of the repository page). Repository settings can't be changed through the connected GitHub integration, so apply these by hand.

**Description:**

> A Plex year in review for any server: Instagram slides, a single-page infographic or an animated video with sound, in seven designed styles. Runs locally from a Plex database backup, no Plex token needed.

**Website:** leave blank until there is a hosted demo or project page.

**Topics:**

`plex`, `plex-media-server`, `year-in-review`, `wrapped`, `rewind`, `infographic`, `instagram`, `video`, `data-visualization`, `self-hosted`, `homelab`, `python`, `playwright`, `ffmpeg`, `cli`

**Features to mention in social posts:**

- Five-slide carousel, single-page infographic, or a 30-second animated video with sound
- Seven designed styles: editorial, marquee, ticket, broadsheet, terminal, swiss, vhs
- Works for any server name; long names shrink to fit
- Every number comes from your stats; nothing is estimated
- Runs locally from a standalone Plex database backup, with no Plex token or hosted service
- Optional thank-you or donation closing slide, with your own donation options
- Color templates in `templates/`; a new style is one stylesheet

**How to apply:** open https://github.com/antonflor/rewind-studio, click the gear icon next to **About**, paste the description, add the topics, and save.
